title: Gym bag essentials
prompt_en: Vertical 9:16 top-down. Hands place items one by one into an open gym bag: water bottle, towel, headphones, shoes. Bright natural light, wooden floor, quick casual pace.
prompt_zh: 竖屏 9:16 俯拍。双手把物品逐一放进打开的健身包：水瓶、毛巾、耳机、鞋子。明亮自然光，木地板，节奏轻快随意。
why_it_works: 'What's in my bag' list format gives a clear sequence the model can follow.
